criterion_text: An official MCP client negotiates `2026-07-28`, performs `server/discover`, `tools/list` and `tools/call` **without legacy session/initialization**, validates applicable standard headers/client/server metadata and version/error behavior, and receives correct result shapes. Verifier: raw HTTP + official-client protocol Case.

verifiers.summary: an official client negotiates the modern stateless protocol and completes discovery and tool calls; required headers, metadata and version errors are validated

evidence.value: staging SHA 00fd6c624e9907c14df6003b94bd2002606a9973: an official rmcp client negotiated 2026-07-28 via server/discover and completed tools/list and tools/call with no initialize and no Mcp-Session-Id; the result carried the four Tools and correct content
